items.note: TRAI 2025 rules: the message type is shown by a header suffix '-P', '-S', '-T', '-G' (Promotional, Service, Transactional, Government); 'minimum thirty percent characters in the Content Template shall be fixed content'; each variable must be pre-tagged for its purpose; one template may not be linked to more than one header; messages with URLs/APKs/OTT links/call-back numbers pass scrubbing only if whitelisted by the sender; a promotional message must carry an opt-out mechanism in the same message, and promotional content mixed into a service/transactional SMS makes the whole message promotional. The 'three variables' cap is implied by the clause allowing MORE than three only on justified request. CONFLICT/gap: the 6-character header length (6 letters for service/transactional, 6 digits for promotional, first digit = business category) comes from operator DLT portals and SMS vendors, not from the TRAI text, which speaks of an 11-character alphanumeric string; treat 6 as operator practice (low confidence). limits.quote: A short headline (at least 1, or up to 5 headlines, of 30 characters or fewer).
A long headline (90 characters or fewer).
at least 1, or up to 5 headlines
A description (at least 1, or up to 5 descriptions).

sources.title: Create a responsive display ad - Google Ads Help
sources.supports: headline, long headline and description counts

items.note: Description length is not stated on this page (not recorded). The ad shows the business name exactly as entered, so spell and capitalize it correctly. Short headlines may appear with or without the description.

items.name: Microsoft Advertising audience (responsive) ads
items.one_line: Native/display ads on the Microsoft Audience Network (MSN, Outlook, Edge) built from headlines, long headlines and descriptions.

limits.quote: The upperlimit of headlines is 15. And the length of each headline is limited to 30 characters.
The upperlimit of long headlines is 5. And the length of each headline is limited to 90 characters.
The upper limit of descriptions is 5. The length of the string is limited to 90 characters.
The length of the string is limited to 25 characters.
The upperlimit of headlines is 15.
The upperlimit of long headlines is 5.
The upper limit of descriptions is 5.

sources.title: Responsive Ad Record - Bulk - Microsoft Advertising API (Microsoft Learn)

items.note: Source is Microsoft's API reference; the business name may appear depending on placement.

items.name: Telegram Ads (sponsored messages in channels)
items.one_line: Short text-only sponsored messages with one button, shown in large public Telegram channels and bots.

limits.quote: The maximum length of the ad text is 160 characters including spaces.
ads may also include one optional link in the ad text itself

sources.title: Telegram Ad Platform guidelines (ads.telegram.org)
sources.supports: ad format, editorial and link rules

items.note: Editorial rules (same page) disallow vague or repetitive copy, 'Excessive or gimmicky use of CaPiTaLiZaTiOn', intrusive or gimmicky emoji, and (per the guidelines) line breaks, bullet points and numbered lists. The in-text link must use the @link / t.me/link format and lead to the same destination as the ad link. Organic Telegram channel posts belong to plat_social.
